exposure: Safety Program for Perinatal Care (SPPC) implementation
outcome: adverse events (Modified Adverse Outcome Index - MAOI)
cohort: The study included 43 Labor & Delivery units which submitted data representing 97,740 deliveries.
finding: The Safety Program for Perinatal Care (SPPC) had a favorable impact on unit patient safety culture and processes, but its short-term impact on maternal and neonatal adverse events was mixed.
mod_finding: Statistically significant decreases were observed in indicators for obstetric trauma without instruments and primary cesarean delivery.
